title: Oral fluid therapy of cholera among Bangladesh refugees
version: Historical account and Table 1, 2012 WHO journal reprint
lineage: Notes paraphrase selected source passages; not a source copy.

passages.locator: Historical account and Table 1, 2012 WHO journal reprint
passages.note: The authors report oral rehydration delivered in 1971 by teams with relatives and paramedical workers at Bongaon, India. Of 3,703 admitted to the whole centre, 135 died; care included oral and intravenous therapy as appropriate. These observational outcomes do not isolate an effect of oral therapy.
